name: withdraw_check_then_act
title: Withdrawals from a wallet
body: Adds Wallets.withdraw for the payout endpoint, which runs on the request threads.
diff:
### payments/wallets.py (modified, +7/-0)
@@ -15,3 +15,10 @@
     def balance(self, wallet_id: str) -> int:
         with self._lock:
             return self._balances.get(wallet_id, 0)
+
+    def withdraw(self, wallet_id: str, cents: int) -> None:
+        """Take `cents` out; called from the request threads."""
+        if self.balance(wallet_id) < cents:
+            raise InsufficientFunds(wallet_id)
+        with self._lock:
+            self._balances[wallet_id] -= cents

defects.what: the balance check and the debit take the lock separately: two concurrent withdrawals both pass the check and overdraw
